assumptions.scenario_range: Model sensitivity only; percentile bands are not calibrated confidence intervals
assumptions.future_score_interpretation: Future player talent uses only position, 2026 roster age and current RosterAudit value. One shared league-wide scoring scale targets 1,570–1,630 PPG, centered at the historic 1,600 baseline. Past individual player/team PPG do not enter the talent model.
assumptions.future_player_model: Position-specific market-implied PPG, pre-peak maturation, veteran decline and uncertain career breakouts; future rookies use RosterAudit draft-pick value tiers and unknown sampled positions.
assumptions.player_forecast_interpretation: Future fantasy PPG from the exact team simulation; current RosterAudit values are historical present-day reference only, never projected resale values

validation.description: Historical one-year tests did not consistently beat the simpler roster scoring baseline. The model is research only.

league_scoring_reference.description: Actual completed 10-team weeks independently check the league-wide 1,600-point baseline; past individual player/team scoring never sets talent projections
